proved_claims.scope: One original scalar square with arbitrary independent adapted shift and additive remainder; H_beta bound for every beta<1/2.
Three mutually independent original scalar coordinates completed in triangular/adapted order, arbitrary final remainder; essential bounded density.
Matrix corollary for three successive nonzero literal scalar Schur pivots.
Partner zero-triple-currency support-one endpoint with nonzero support pivot and exact cancellation; qualitative closure via diagonal Schur residual and third square.

key_bound: For cap-one inputs, beta=1/4: ||p_Q||inf <= 12.194582301486003 |a0|^-1/2 |a1|^-1/3 |a2|^-1/6 for three adapted original squares.

partner.actual_application: Partner exact-W2 family has Delta=1/2, giving ||p_Q||inf <= 8*2^(1/4)=9.5136569200...; its zero triple currency forces transverse support <=2, used to isolate and close the support-one cancellation endpoint.
